javax.management.monitor

接口 GaugeMonitorMBean

  • 所有超级接口:

    所有已知实现类:

    public interface GaugeMonitorMBean
extends MonitorMBean
    Exposes the remote management interface of the gauge monitor MBean.

        参数:
